description: Regen per tick (T-037; max((level+20)*health/750, 1) every 30 s, and three times that every 21st fast tick while resting): one arena fight to lose hit points (cut short at single-digit hit points), up the stairs to the Narrow Road (monster group 0: nothing spawns or follows), `rest`, three minutes of prompts. stats.py compares the set of hit point gains between prompts.

the prompt's numbers only, never its labels (as m4)
